name: Bandit
tagline: A wisecracking front end for coordinating the bots you already run
description: A coordination layer that sits over your existing bots and tasks, handing work out and keeping track of where things stand from one place. What sets it apart is the delivery rather than the plumbing: it is styled as a cyberpunk sidekick with a sarcastic streak, so the commentary along the way has some character to it.
author: BitsOfJT
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
